liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Black Tooth (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 14 archived performances [5]
- **Dead-Beat (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 11 archived performances [5]
- **Dirt (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 10 archived performances [5]
- **Alien Metal (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 5 archived performances [5]
- **Kill for the Steel (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 4 archived performances [5]
- **Alter Me II (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 12 archived performances [5]
- **Gliese 710 (Live at Field of Vision II '26)**: rare: 4 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **kglw2026-08-15.SBD** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 176 min [1]
- **kglw2026-08-15.mk21.flac24**: source not stated; 23 songs; 176 min [2]
- **kglw2026-08-15**: source not stated; 24 songs; 175 min [4]
- **kglw2026-08-15.Thor**: source not stated; 23 songs; 176 min [3]

## Around the show

- Continued from the previous night, featuring only the third part and Crumbling Castle teases [1]
- Introduced as being called The River and played for the first time since 2024-11-09 [1]
- Played for the first time since 2022-04-18, a gap of 239 shows [3]
- Contained a The River quote and jam, while Black Tooth was introduced as The River [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2026-08-15.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joseph Santarpia, Gaspard De Meulemeester, Grace Reader and Brandon DeLapp; source: SBD [1]
- **kglw2026-08-15.mk21.flac24**: taped by Brian Porter; source: Schoeps mk21 (ORTF wide) > kcy > Sonosax SX-M2/LS2 > Sony M10 (24/96) [2]
- **kglw2026-08-15**: taped by Birds; transferred by Skunks; source: x2 Rode NT5 in ORTF > H6 Handy Recorder [4]. Also: Two Rode NT5 microphones in ORTF, recorded to H6 Handy Recorder, then converted to FLAC [4]
- **kglw2026-08-15.Thor**: taped by puffanug; transferred by puffanug; source: ADK T7 Thor (ORTF, 9-1/2' high, ~90' from stage, right front corner of FOH, directly in front of stage left array) > PMD661 (Oade concert mod) > 24/96 wav [3]
